{{Top|leg}}
A '''Garnib crystal''' was a type of sculpture from the world [[Garnib]]. The creation of the crystal had several steps, each requiring a skilled [[Artisan/Legends|artisan]] working in a [[crystal factory]]. [[Sculptor/Legends|Sculptors]] first carved the sculpture out of a block of [[Water/Legends|ice]], using [[sonic smoother]]s. At the same time, a [[gemmaster]] polished and smoothed pieces of gemstones and glass, and carved intricate designs into them. The ice sculpture and gems were taken to a [[crystal mill]], where a [[thread master]] weaved a molecular string containing fragments of gems and glass which was then sewn into the crystal's interior. The sculptor and gemmaster worked together to set the full-sized gems into the crystal. The result was placed in a [[sonic bath]] and inspected by a team of artisans for beauty and value before being sold to [[Galactic Crystal Creations]].
